content.name: Syed Farhan Ali
content.title: Senior Retail Sales Associate
content.summary: Retail sales associate with nearly ten years in electronics, home furnishings and premium watches in Hyderabad. Delivers ₹1.6 crore in personal annual sales at a luxury watch boutique, built on a loyal client base and after-sales care in four languages.

experience.title: Senior Retail Sales Associate
experience.company: HITEC City Watch Boutique Pvt Ltd
bullets: Achieved ₹1.6 crore in personal sales in FY 2025-26, 22% above target, with an average bill of ₹1.4 lakh.
Maintain a client register of 650 buyers and invite them to new-collection previews, which convert about one in four attendees.
Coordinate servicing and warranty repairs with brand service centres, keeping customers updated by WhatsApp until pickup.
Guide two junior associates on product features, GST invoicing and EMI financing options.

experience.title: Senior Sales Associate
bullets: Sold sofas, curtains and custom upholstery to homeowners and interior designers, averaging ₹11 lakh in monthly sales.
Took measurements at customer homes and prepared quotes, cutting order errors on curtains by a third.
Started a referral scheme with 18 interior designers that brought in ₹65 lakh of business in its first year.

experience.title: Sales Associate
bullets: Demonstrated smartphones, televisions and air conditioners to walk-in customers, closing around 14 sales a day in peak season.
Processed consumer durable loans with finance partners and explained terms clearly to first-time buyers.
Ranked first among 12 floor staff for extended warranty sales during the Diwali and Sankranti sale periods.

courses.name: Retail Sales Associate (Retailers Association's Skill Council of India qualification)

achievements.title: Top boutique seller
achievements.detail: Highest personal sales in the boutique for FY 2024-25 and FY 2025-26.

achievements.title: Designer referral scheme
achievements.detail: Designer referrals contributed ₹65 lakh in one year.
